title: The Elle and Emmett Couples Costume
intro: The couples costume where she does the heavy lifting and he only has to own a corduroy blazer. Her half is a hot pink fit and flare mini, pink kitten heel slingbacks, a quilted pink bag on a gold chain, heart huggies and a big satin bow. His half is one brown blazer, which is the most anyone has ever successfully asked a boyfriend to wear. You both know who is wearing that blazer by ten o'clock. Everything on her side goes straight back into the closet for birthdays and date nights, so the costume is really an excuse to buy a great pink dress.

items.name: Hot pink square neck fit and flare mini dress
Men's brown corduroy blazer (his half of the costume)
Hot pink pointed toe kitten heel slingbacks
Hot pink quilted crossbody bag with gold chain
Hot pink satin hair bow clip
